name: Technicalities Legal
overview: The Scriptures reveal how the Pharisees and scribes focused on strict legalistic observance of the Sabbath, accusing Jesus and His disciples of unlawful actions such as healing and picking grain on that holy day. Their intent was to find fault with Jesus by emphasizing technicalities of the law rather than understanding its true purpose. These passages demonstrate the danger of elevating human traditions and legalistic details above the compassionate and redemptive work of Christ.
